# AGENTS.md

Source: https://github.com/fxembed/fxembed/blob/main/AGENTS.md

# AGENTS.md

This is the repository for FxEmbed, the home of FxTwitter, FixupX, and FxBluesky. FxEmbed generates rich embeds for social media posts (X/Twitter, Bluesky, TikTok) for chat platforms like Discord and Telegram. There is a public API provided for X/Twitter, Bluesky and such, the modern v2 API generates an OpenAPI spec. Typically deployed using Cloudflare Workers, this TypeScript app uses Hono for routing, i18next localization, zod API validation.

## @fxembed/atmosphere (monorepo package)

- **Path:** `packages/atmosphere/`. The worker and tests import it via `"@fxembed/atmosphere"`.
- **Build:** `npm run build:atmosphere` (runs before the worker build).
- **Transports:** `public` | `anonymous-proxy` (credentials) | `proxy-relay` (to another host’s OpenAPI) | `authenticated` (interface stub, not implemented) — see `packages/atmosphere/src/transports/`.
- **Bluesky:** runtime wiring (API roots, proxy) — `setBlueskyProviderEnv` + `setBlueskyProxyRuntime` from `worker.ts` and `@fxembed/atmosphere/providers/bluesky-runtime`.
- **Proxy-relay OpenAPI (optional):** `npm run openapi:atmosphere` fetches public specs and writes `packages/atmosphere/src/relay/generated/`. Use `createRelayFetch` from `@fxembed/atmosphere` for `User-Agent` + API key injection.
- **Self-hosting:** docs site `/deployment/atmosphere-transports/` — public-only, own proxy pool, relay to `https://api.fxtwitter.com` / `https://api.fxbsky.app`, or mixed. Mastodon / Twitter / TikTok providers remain under `src/providers/*`; follow the Bluesky → `@fxembed/atmosphere` migration pattern when moving more code.

## Environment variables

Environment variables are generally set in .env, not in Wrangler, except for certain secrets such as CREDENTIAL_KEY. When adding an environment variable, you generally have to add them in the following places for them to be included correctly during a build:

- `.env.example` (for documentation)
- `esbuild.config.mjs` (so it's passed to the worker during build)
- `vitest.config.mts` (for tests)
- `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` (So GitHub Actions variables/secrets are given to it during deployment)
- `src/types/env.d.ts` (for type documentation)
- `src/constants.ts` (We typically load all environment variables under the Constants object)

## Cursor Cloud specific instructions

### Prerequisites

- **Node.js Latest LTS (Currently 24.14.x)** (CI uses `24.14.1`). The VM uses nvm; run `source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24.14.1` before any npm commands.
- Config files must exist before build/test: copy `wrangler.example.toml` → `wrangler.toml` and `.env.example` → `.env` if they don't already exist. `branding.json` is auto-copied from `branding.example.json` during build if missing.

### Key commands

| Task          | Command                                                        |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Install deps  | `npm install`                                                  |
| Lint          | `npm run lint:eslint`                                          |
| Format        | `npm run prettier`                                             |
| Build (local) | `npm run build-local`                                          |
| Test          | `npm run test`                                                 |
| Dev server    | `npx wrangler dev --local` (serves on `http://localhost:8787`) |

### Docs site (`docs/`)

- Guide screenshots are static assets under `docs/public/guide/readme/` (served as `/guide/readme/*` in the docs site).
- Refresh API reference specs from **production**: `cd docs && npm run extract-openapi`
- Refresh from your **local worker** (after `wrangler dev --local`): `cd docs && npm run extract-openapi:local` (default port `8787`; custom: `npm run extract-openapi:local -- 9000`). The script sets `Host` to `api.fxtwitter.com` / `api.fxbsky.app` so routing matches production.
- Then `npm run dev` in `docs/` to preview.

### Dev server testing notes

- The worker routes by `Host` header. Use `-H "Host: fxtwitter.com"` (or `fxbsky.app`, `api.fxtwitter.com`, etc.) with curl to hit different realms.
- Embed responses require a bot User-Agent (e.g. `-H "User-Agent: Discordbot/2.0"`); otherwise the worker redirects to the original platform.
- Tests run inside Miniflare (local Cloudflare Workers simulator) via `@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers` and use extensive mocks in `test/mocks/` — no real API credentials needed.
- No Cloudflare account or authentication is required for build, test, or local dev.

### Gotchas

- `credentials.enc.json` is optional; build gracefully falls back to empty strings if missing.
- `wrangler dev` triggers a build automatically (via the `[build]` section in `wrangler.toml`).

---

# introduction.mdx

Source: https://github.com/fxembed/fxembed/blob/main/docs/src/content/docs/api/introduction.mdx

title: API Overview
description: Introduction to the FxEmbed JSON APIs for X/Twitter, Bluesky, and Mastodon.

FxEmbed provides a public API for X/Twitter and Bluesky. These are the same APIs that power the embed service itself and more.

We've built abstractions between different platforms to make it easier to support multiple at once and adapt your own work between them.

## Available APIs

FxEmbed provides three separate API surfaces:

### FxTwitter API

The most feature-complete API, covering X/Twitter data.

- **Base URL**: `https://api.fxtwitter.com`
- **Spec**: [FxTwitter API Reference](/api/twitter/operations/)
- Posts, threads, conversations, profiles, search, trends, typeahead

### FxBluesky API

Bluesky / AT Protocol data, with response shapes aligned to the FxTwitter API where applicable.

- **Base URL**: `https://api.fxbsky.app`
- **Spec**: [FxBluesky API Reference](/api/bluesky/operations/)
- Posts, threads, conversations, profiles, search

## Versioning

All current endpoints are under the `/2/` path prefix (API v2). The legacy v1 endpoints (i.e., `/:handle/status/:id`) still work for backward compatibility but don't support all the latest features.

## Response Format

All API responses are JSON with `Content-Type: application/json`. Every response includes a `code` field that mirrors the HTTP status code, making it easy to check for errors even when the HTTP status is `200`.

```json
{
  "code": 200,
  "status": {
    "id": "123456789",
    "url": "https://twitter.com/user/status/123456789",
    "text": "Hello, world!",
    "author": { ... },
    "media": { ... },
    ...
  }
}
```

## Pagination

List endpoints (search results, timelines, followers, etc.) return a `cursor` object with `top` and `bottom` fields. Pass `cursor.bottom` as the `cursor` query parameter to fetch the next page.

```json
{
  "code": 200,
  "results": [ ... ],
  "cursor": {
    "top": "...",
    "bottom": "..."
  }
}
```

## Rate limiting

API v2 has a rate limit of 1000 requests per minute (16.7 requests per second) per IP address.
We believe this is generous enough for most legitimate applications.
If you need more, it might be worth [self-hosting](/deployment/) your own instance.

## OpenAPI specifications

Machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 specs are available at runtime:

- FxTwitter: `https://api.fxtwitter.com/2/openapi.json`
- FxBluesky: `https://api.fxbsky.app/2/openapi.json`

---

# configuration.mdx

Source: https://github.com/fxembed/fxembed/blob/main/docs/src/content/docs/deployment/configuration.mdx

title: Configuration
description: Environment variables, wrangler.toml settings, and branding configuration for FxEmbed.

FxEmbed is configured through environment variables (`.env`), Wrangler settings (`wrangler.toml`), and an optional branding file (`branding.json`).

## Environment Variables

Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and configure:

### Domain Lists

These comma-separated lists define which domains route to which realm:

| Variable                      | Description             | Example                                |
| ----------------------------- | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `STANDARD_DOMAIN_LIST`        | X/Twitter embed domains | `fxtwitter.com,fixupx.com,twittpr.com` |
| `STANDARD_BSKY_DOMAIN_LIST`   | Bluesky embed domains   | `fxbsky.app`                           |
| `STANDARD_TIKTOK_DOMAIN_LIST` | TikTok embed domains    | `fixtok.example.com`                   |

### Subdomain Feature Domains

| Variable               | Description                           | Example                            |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `DIRECT_MEDIA_DOMAINS` | `d.`/`dl.` direct media subdomains    | `d.fxtwitter.com,dl.fxtwitter.com` |
| `TEXT_ONLY_DOMAINS`    | `t.` text-only subdomains             | `t.fxtwitter.com`                  |
| `INSTANT_VIEW_DOMAINS` | `i.` Telegram Instant View subdomains | `i.fxtwitter.com`                  |
| `GALLERY_DOMAINS`      | `g.` gallery subdomains               | `g.fxtwitter.com`                  |
| `FORCE_MOSAIC_DOMAINS` | `m.` mosaic subdomains                | `m.fxtwitter.com`                  |
| `OLD_EMBED_DOMAINS`    | `o.` legacy embed subdomains          | `o.fxtwitter.com`                  |

### API Domains

| Variable                | Description           | Example             |
| ----------------------- | --------------------- | ------------------- |
| `API_HOST_LIST`         | FxTwitter API host(s) | `api.fxtwitter.com` |
| `BLUESKY_API_HOST_LIST` | FxBluesky API host(s) | `api.fxbsky.app`    |

### Service Domains

| Variable                           | Description                                 |
| ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `MOSAIC_DOMAIN_LIST`               | Mosaic image generation service endpoint(s) |
| `GIF_TRANSCODE_DOMAIN_LIST`        | GIF transcoding service endpoint(s)         |
| `VIDEO_TRANSCODE_DOMAIN_LIST`      | Video transcoding service endpoint(s)       |
| `VIDEO_TRANSCODE_BSKY_DOMAIN_LIST` | Bluesky video transcoding endpoint(s)       |
| `POLYGLOT_DOMAIN_LIST`             | Translation service endpoint(s)             |
| `POLYGLOT_ACCESS_TOKEN`            | Translation service access token            |
| `TWITTER_ROOT`                     | Base Twitter/X URL for redirects            |

### Sentry (Error Reporting)

| Variable            | Description                                      |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `SENTRY_DSN`        | Sentry Data Source Name (leave empty to disable) |
| `SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN` | Sentry authentication token for source maps      |
| `SENTRY_ORG`        | Sentry organization slug                         |
| `SENTRY_PROJECT`    | Sentry project slug                              |

## Wrangler Configuration

The `wrangler.toml` file configures the Cloudflare Worker:

```toml
name = "fxembed"
account_id = "YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID"
main = "./dist/worker.js"
compatibility_date = "2026-04-11"
send_metrics = false

analytics_engine_datasets = [
  { binding = "AnalyticsEngine" }
]

[build]
command = "npm run build"
```

### Key Settings

- **`name`**: Worker name (appears in `*.workers.dev` URL)
- **`account_id`**: Your [Cloudflare Account ID](https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/get-started/basic-tasks/find-account-and-zone-ids/)
- **`compatibility_date`**: Cloudflare Workers API compatibility date
- **`analytics_engine_datasets`**: Remove this block if you don't use Cloudflare Analytics Engine

### Secrets

Some values should be set as Wrangler secrets rather than in `.env` or `wrangler.toml`:

```bash
wrangler secret put CREDENTIAL_KEY
wrangler secret put EXCEPTION_DISCORD_WEBHOOK
```

- **`CREDENTIAL_KEY`**: Encryption key for credential storage
- **`EXCEPTION_DISCORD_WEBHOOK`**: Discord webhook URL for exception notifications

## Branding

Copy `branding.example.json` to `branding.json` to customize the appearance and behavior of each domain zone.

Each zone in the `zones` array defines:

```json
{
  "name": "FxTwitter",
  "default": true,
  "domains": ["fxtwitter.com", "twittpr.com"],
  "provider": "twitter",
  "favicon": "https://example.com/favicon.ico",
  "redirect": "https://github.com/FxEmbed/FxEmbed",
  "color": "#6363ff",
  "activityIcons": {
    "default": "https://example.com/icon32.png",
    "svg": "https://example.com/icon.svg",
    "16": "https://example.com/icon16.png",
    "32": "https://example.com/icon32.png"
  }
}
```

| Field           | Description                                                                           |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`          | Display name for this zone                                                            |
| `default`       | Whether this is the default zone (only one should be `true`)                          |
| `domains`       | Domains this zone applies to                                                          |
| `provider`      | Content provider (`twitter`, `bluesky`, `tiktok`)                                     |
| `favicon`       | URL to the favicon served for this zone                                               |
| `redirect`      | Where bare domain visits redirect to                                                  |
| `color`         | Theme color for embeds (hex)                                                          |
| `activityIcons` | Icon URLs at various sizes; `activityIcons` can also be an array for random selection |

---

# credentials.mdx

Source: https://github.com/fxembed/fxembed/blob/main/docs/src/content/docs/deployment/credentials.mdx

title: Credentials
description: Setting up X/Twitter credentials for your FxEmbed deployment.

FxEmbed works best with X/Twitter account credentials to fetch post data from the Twitter API. Without them, you will have lower rate limits and not be able to fetch NSFW posts.

## Credential Format

Credentials are defined in a `credentials.json` file:

```json
{
  "twitter": {
    "accounts": [
      {
        "authToken": "your_auth_token",
        "csrfToken": "your_ct0_csrf",
        "username": "account_screen_name"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

You can include multiple accounts in the `accounts` array. FxEmbed will use them to distribute requests.

### Obtaining Tokens

The `authToken` and `csrfToken` values come from an authenticated X/Twitter web session. You can extract them from your browser's cookies:

- **`authToken`**: The `auth_token` cookie
- **`csrfToken`**: The `ct0` cookie or `X-Csrf-Token` header

## Credential Management Scripts

FxEmbed includes tooling to encrypt, push, and pull credentials:

### Encrypt Credentials

Encrypt your `credentials.json` using your `CREDENTIAL_KEY`:

```bash
npm run credentials:encrypt
```

### Push to R2

Upload encrypted credentials to Cloudflare R2 storage:

```bash
npm run credentials:push
```

### Encrypt and Push

Combined encrypt + push in one step:

```bash
npm run credentials:encrypt-push
```

### Pull from R2

Download and decrypt credentials from R2:

```bash
npm run credentials:pull
```

### Add CSRF Tokens

Refresh CSRF tokens for existing credentials:

```bash
npm run credentials:add-csrf
```

### Strip Credentials

Remove sensitive data from the credentials file:

```bash
npm run credentials:strip
```

## Setting the Credential Key

The encryption key must be set as a Wrangler secret so the deployed worker can decrypt credentials at runtime:

```bash
wrangler secret put CREDENTIAL_KEY
```

## Bluesky

FxEmbed by default will use the public Bluesky AppView API. We support specifying fallback accounts on different PDSes in the event of downtime of the public API. We will always prefer the public API unless it is down.

The proxy uses standard Bluesky [app passwords](https://bsky.app/settings/app-passwords) — no OAuth flow, no DPoP, nothing exotic.

### Credential Format

Bluesky accounts live alongside Twitter accounts in the same `credentials.json`:

```json
{
  "bluesky": {
    "accounts": [
      {
        "identifier": "your.handle.bsky.social",
        "appPassword": "xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx",
        "service": "https://bsky.social"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Fields:

- **`identifier`**: The account's handle (e.g. `your.handle.bsky.social`) or DID.
- **`appPassword`**: An app password generated at [bsky.app/settings/app-passwords](https://bsky.app/settings/app-passwords). Do **not** use the account's main password.
- **`service`**: The base URL of the account's PDS. For accounts hosted on Bluesky's infrastructure, use `https://bsky.social` (the entryway will route to the correct `*.host.bsky.network` PDS automatically). For self-hosted or third-party PDSes, set this to the actual PDS URL (e.g. `https://pds.example.com`).

### Generating an App Password

1. Sign in to the account you want to use as a proxy.
2. Open **Settings → Privacy and security → App passwords** (or visit [bsky.app/settings/app-passwords](https://bsky.app/settings/app-passwords) directly).
3. Click **Add App Password**, give it a descriptive name (e.g. `FxEmbed Proxy`), and copy the generated `xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx` value.
4. Paste it into the `appPassword` field above.

App passwords can be revoked at any time from the same screen if a key is ever compromised.

### Encryption and Deployment

Bluesky credentials are encrypted, pushed, and pulled using the exact same [credential management scripts](#credential-management-scripts) and [`CREDENTIAL_KEY`](#setting-the-credential-key) as Twitter — there's nothing Bluesky-specific to configure on the worker side.

---

# index.mdx

Source: https://github.com/fxembed/fxembed/blob/main/docs/src/content/docs/deployment/index.mdx

title: Self-Hosting
description: Deploy your own instance of FxEmbed on Cloudflare Workers.

FxEmbed is designed to run on [Cloudflare Workers](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/), which are free for up to 100,000 requests per day per account. Because Workers run on Cloudflare's global edge network, your instance will automatically be distributed worldwide for low latency.

:::note
FxEmbed is built with [Hono](https://hono.dev/), so it may be possible to run on other web-standards-compliant runtimes, but we recommend using Cloudflare Workers for the easiest deployment.
:::

## Prerequisites

- Latest [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) LTS (Currently 24.14.x)
- A [Cloudflare account](https://dash.cloudflare.com/sign-up)
- Your [Cloudflare Account ID](https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/get-started/basic-tasks/find-account-and-zone-ids/)

## Steps

### 1. Clone and Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/FxEmbed/FxEmbed.git
cd FxEmbed
npm install
```

### 2. Configure Wrangler

Copy the example Wrangler config and fill in your details:

```bash
cp wrangler.example.toml wrangler.toml
```

Edit `wrangler.toml` and set your Cloudflare Account ID:

```toml
name = "fxembed"
account_id = "YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID_HERE"
main = "./dist/worker.js"
compatibility_date = "2026-04-11"
```

If you don't need Cloudflare Analytics Engine, remove the `analytics_engine_datasets` section.

### 3. Configure Environment Variables

Copy the example environment file and customize it:

```bash
cp .env.example .env
```

See the [Configuration guide](/deployment/configuration/) for details on each variable.

### 4. Configure Branding (Optional)

Copy and edit the branding configuration:

```bash
cp branding.example.json branding.json
```

You can configure the name, colors, icons, and redirect URLs for each zone you want to support. See [Configuration](/deployment/configuration/#branding) for details.

### 5. Authenticate and Deploy

Deploy to Cloudflare:

```bash
npm run deploy
```

This builds the worker with esbuild and deploys it via `wrangler deploy --no-bundle`.

### 6. Set Up Custom Domain

Once your worker is running on `*.workers.dev`, [add it to your custom domain](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/routing/custom-domains/) through the Cloudflare dashboard.

## Building Locally

To build without deploying (useful for testing):

```bash
npm run build-local
```

This runs esbuild without the Sentry upload step.

## Viewing Logs

To tail real-time logs from your deployed worker:

```bash
npm run log
```

This runs `wrangler tail` to stream logs to your terminal.

## Updating

Pull the latest changes and redeploy:

```bash
git pull
npm install
npm run deploy
```

## Further Reading

- [Self-hosting Mosaic](/deployment/mosaic/) (optional multi-image service)
- [Cloudflare Workers Getting Started](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/get-started/guide/)
- [Configuration Reference](/deployment/configuration/)
- [Credentials Setup](/deployment/credentials/)

---

# Clone and build

Source: https://github.com/fxembed/fxembed/blob/main/docs/src/content/docs/deployment/mosaic.mdx

title: Mosaic
description: Run the mosaic multi-image service with Docker and wire it to FxEmbed.

[Mosaic](https://github.com/FxEmbed/mosaic) is FxEmbed's service to combine multiple images into a single composite image.

## Running mosaic in Docker (easiest)

This will run mosaic on port 3030.

```bash
docker run -d --name mosaic -p 3030:3030 ghcr.io/fxembed/mosaic:latest
```

## Building mosaic from source

You need to have the Rust toolchain installed.

```bash
# Clone and build
git clone https://github.com/FxEmbed/mosaic.git
cd mosaic
cargo build --release

# Run the binary
./target/release/mosaic
```

## URL format

Mosaic URLs are formatted as follows:

```
https://mosaic.fxtwitter.com/jpeg/:tweet_id/:image_id1/:image_id2/:image_id3?/:image_id4?
https://mosaic.fxbsky.app/jpeg/:post_id/:image_id1/:image_id2/:image_id3?/:image_id4?
```

You can specify between 2 and 4 image IDs. The image IDs for Twitter correspond to the filename of the image on the pbs.twimg.com url. On Bluesky, it's the full DID of the image.

## Configure FxEmbed

Set these in `.env` (and mirror them in Wrangler / GitHub Actions if you deploy that way, see [Configuration](/deployment/configuration/)):

| Variable                  | Role                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `MOSAIC_DOMAIN_LIST`      | Hostname(s) of your Mosaic service for **X/Twitter and Mastodon** embeds. Comma-separated if you run more than one; FxEmbed picks one per post for simple load balancing. Use hostnames only (no `https://`). |
| `MOSAIC_BSKY_DOMAIN_LIST` | Same for **Bluesky** embeds (can be the same host or a separate one).                                                                                                                                         |
| `FORCE_MOSAIC_DOMAINS`    | Optional. If you use `m.` subdomains to force mosaic-style embeds, list those hostnames here so routing matches your branding domains.                                                                        |

If you run a single Mosaic instance, set one hostname in each list you need (Twitter/Mastodon vs. Bluesky). Use comma-separated hostnames when you run several Mosaic endpoints and want FxEmbed to spread load across them. Full variable descriptions are in [Configuration](/deployment/configuration/).

---

# custom-branding.mdx

Source: https://github.com/fxembed/fxembed/blob/main/docs/src/content/docs/guide/advanced/custom-branding.mdx

title: Custom Embed Branding
description: Configure FxEmbed to use a custom branding for your domain.

:::caution
This feature is currently disabled due to a caching bug. See https://github.com/FxEmbed/FxEmbed/issues/2025 for more details.
:::

## Custom branding parameters

If you want to use FxEmbed on your own domain and don't want to run your own branded instance, you can append branding overrides directly to the embed URL itself when you redirect traffic through FxEmbed.

- `brandingName`: display name shown in oEmbed responses and page metadata
- `brandingIcon`: custom icon URL (used as the activity icon)
- `brandingRedirectUrl`: alternate redirect URL for this request

Example:

```text
https://fxtwitter.com/i/status/1234567890?brandingName=CustomX&brandingIcon=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.customx.com%2Ficon.png&brandingRedirectUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fhello.customx.com
```

---

# custom-redirect.mdx

Source: https://github.com/fxembed/fxembed/blob/main/docs/src/content/docs/guide/advanced/custom-redirect.mdx

title: Custom Redirect
description: Configure FxEmbed to redirect you to an alternative frontend such as Horizon or Nitter.

You can configure FxEmbed to redirect you to an alternative frontend such as Horizon or Nitter:

```
https://fxtwitter.com/set_base_redirect?url=https://xcancel.com
```

This sets a cookie on the domain you configure it on. If you set it on `fxtwitter.com`, it will not automatically apply to `fixupx.com` — you would need to set it separately on each domain.

---

# rss-atom-feeds.mdx

Source: https://github.com/fxembed/fxembed/blob/main/docs/src/content/docs/guide/advanced/rss-atom-feeds.mdx

title: RSS & Atom feeds
description: Subscribe to X/Twitter and Bluesky profiles with RSS 2.0 or Atom from FxTwitter, FixupX, and FxBluesky.

FxEmbed exposes **RSS 2.0** and **Atom** feeds for **X/Twitter** and **Bluesky** profiles. Use them in feed readers, automation, or any client that polls syndication URLs.

Many readers can automatically detect the feed from an FxTwitter / FixupX / FxBluesky link, but if not, you can also manually add and customize the feed you want to your reader.

## Feed URLs

### X / Twitter

| Format   | All Recent Posts                               |
| -------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| **RSS**  | `https://fxtwitter.com/{handle}/feed.xml`      |
| **Atom** | `https://fxtwitter.com/{handle}/feed.atom.xml` |

| Format   | Media-only Posts                                |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| **RSS**  | `https://fxtwitter.com/{handle}/media.xml`      |
| **Atom** | `https://fxtwitter.com/{handle}/media.atom.xml` |

Replace the host with your deployment’s X realm (for example `fixupx.com` for `x.com` links).

### Bluesky

Paths use `/profile/` before the handle, matching other FxBluesky profile URLs.

| Format   | All Recent Posts                                    |
| -------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| **RSS**  | `https://fxbsky.app/profile/{handle}/feed.xml`      |
| **Atom** | `https://fxbsky.app/profile/{handle}/feed.atom.xml` |

| Format   | Media-only Posts                                     |
| -------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| **RSS**  | `https://fxbsky.app/profile/{handle}/media.xml`      |
| **Atom** | `https://fxbsky.app/profile/{handle}/media.atom.xml` |

`{handle}` is the Bluesky handle (for example `user.bsky.social`), with or without a leading `@` in the path segment.

- **Timeline feeds** include recent posts (original posts and reposts as returned by the profile timeline API).
- **Media feeds** only include posts that have photos or videos—useful if you want a gallery-style stream.

## Query parameters

All parameters are optional.

| Parameter                       | Applies to         | Description                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `count`                         | Timeline and media | Number of items to fetch, **1–100** (default **90**).                                                                                                                        |
| `with_replies` or `withReplies` | Timeline only      | Include reply posts.                                                                                                                                                         |
| `safe`                          | Timeline and media | Hides posts (and quoted bodies) marked sensitive.                                                                                                                            |
| `lang` or `language`            | Timeline and media | Requests for automatic translation of content when available. Currently it's a bit iffy whether it works or not, so don't be surprised if things aren't translated just yet. |

Example (X):

```
https://fxtwitter.com/example/feed.xml?count=50&safe=1
```

Example (Bluesky):

```
https://fxbsky.app/profile/user.bsky.social/feed.xml?count=50&safe=1
```

Query strings are preserved in the feed’s self-link metadata so subscribers and validators see a stable identity per URL variant.

## What readers get

- **RSS** is RSS 2.0 with an Atom `rel="self"` link, `guid` per item (permalink to the post on X or Bluesky), and HTML `description` content (CDATA). Video items use **Media RSS** (`media:thumbnail`) when a poster image exists.
- **Atom** is RFC 4287 with `content type="html"` entries and a feed-level author when a display name is available.
- **Channel artwork**: profile avatar is exposed as RSS `<image>` and Atom `<icon>` when present.
- **Enclosures**: the first suitable attachment is attached as `enclosure` / `rel="enclosure"`—photos and GIFs as images, videos as **progressive MP4** (not HLS) when available. If a post has no media but has a link preview card with an image, that image may be used as the enclosure.

---

# built-in-features.mdx

Source: https://github.com/fxembed/fxembed/blob/main/docs/src/content/docs/guide/built-in-features.mdx

title: Built-In Features
description: Translation, Telegram Instant View, Nitter redirect, and other advanced FxEmbed features.

## Videos and GIFs

Videos and GIFs embed and play inline in Discord, Telegram, and other clients. You can even ⭐️ favorite GIFs in Discord to use later!

## Link Shortener Replacement

FxEmbed automatically replaces `t.co` shortened links in X/Twitter posts with their original destination URLs. This makes it clear where links point before clicking them.

## Polls (X/Twitter)

Polls are embedded and displayed with the full results, including each option's label, vote count, and percentage. We even support ongoing polls, although platforms typically cache the contents of embeds for a while.

## Telegram Instant View

When sharing FxEmbed links in Telegram, threads are rendered using Telegram's Instant View, allowing you to read entire conversation threads without leaving the app or opening a browser.

Instant View will:

- Unroll the full thread from any linked post
- Track replied-to posts back to the start of the conversation
- Display media, quotes, and other rich content inline

Normally, we will automatically enable Instant View when appropriate. You can also use the `i.` subdomain to explicitly request Instant View rendering:

```
https://i.fxtwitter.com/user/status/123456789
https://i.fixupx.com/user/status/123456789
https://i.fxbsky.app/profile/user.bsky.social/post/abc123
```

## Tracking Parameter Removal

When FxEmbed redirects to the original post, it strips tracking parameters (like `?s` and `&t` on X/Twitter URLs) that are only used for telemetry and advertising.

---

# compare.mdx

Source: https://github.com/fxembed/fxembed/blob/main/docs/src/content/docs/guide/compare.mdx

title: Compare Features
description: Compare FxEmbed features with other alternatives.

## Comparison with Alternatives

|                                        |         FxTwitter / FixupX         | Default |       vxTwitter (fixvx)        |
| -------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------: | :-----: | :----------------------------: |
| Embed Posts / Image                    |                 ✅                 |   ✅    |               ✅               |
| Embed profile pictures on posts        |                 ✅                 |   ❌    |         ☑️ If no media         |
| Embed Videos                           |                 ✅                 |   ❌    |               ✅               |
| Embed External Videos (YouTube, etc.)  |                ✅¹                 |   ❌    |               ❌               |
| Embed Poll results                     |                 ✅                 |   ❌    |               ✅               |
| Embed Quotes                           |                 ✅                 |   ❌    |        ☑️ Without Media        |
| Embed Multiple Images                  |                 ✅                 |   ❌    |               ✅               |
| Native Multi-Image (Discord)           |                 ✅                 |   ❌    |               ❌               |
| Translate Posts                        |                 ✅                 |   ❌    |               ❌               |
| Replace t.co with original links       |                 ✅                 |   ❌    |    ☑️ Not Linked on Discord    |
| Redirect to media file (without embed) |                 ✅                 |   ❌    | ☑️ Subdomain broken, no images |
| Gallery view                           |                 ✅                 |   ❌    |               ❌               |
| Strip tracking info on redirect        |                 ✅                 |   ❌    |               ✅               |
| Show date / time of post               | ☑️ Discord / Telegram Instant View |   ❌    |               ❌               |
| Show retweet, like, reply, view counts | ☑️ Discord / Telegram Instant View |   ❌    |       ➖ Not on Discord        |
| Discord sed replace (`s/`) friendly    |  ☑️ twittpr.com with twitter.com   |   N/A   |               ❌               |
| Telegram Instant View                  |                 ✅                 |   ❌    |               ❌               |
| Basic fetch API                        |   ✅ Comprehensive Developer API   |   N/A   |       ☑️ Basic Fetch API       |
| RSS & Atom feeds                       |                 ✅                 |   N/A   |               ❌               |
| Last commit                            |           [![][flc]][fc]           |   N/A   |         [![][vlc]][vc]         |

[flc]: https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/FxEmbed/FxEmbed?label
[vlc]: https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/dylanpdx/BetterTwitFix?label
[fc]: https://github.com/FxEmbed/FxEmbed/commits
[vc]: https://github.com/dylanpdx/BetterTwitFix/commits

¹ External media requiring web containers, such as YouTube, won't embed in Telegram because Telegram doesn't support it. Plain media will work in Telegram, and it works either way inside Discord.

# faq.mdx

Source: https://github.com/fxembed/fxembed/blob/main/docs/src/content/docs/guide/faq.mdx

title: FAQ
description: Frequently asked questions about FxEmbed, FxTwitter, FixupX, and FxBluesky.

## What's the difference between `fxtwitter.com`, `fixupx.com` and `twittpr.com`?

They all run the exact same worker and function identically.

- **`fxtwitter.com`** is the primary domain for `twitter.com` links
- **`fixupx.com`** makes it easy to fix `x.com` links (short `.com` domains are expensive)
- **`twittpr.com`** was designed for Discord's sed-style replacement — send a `twitter.com` link, then type `s/e/p` to automatically edit it

## How come embedding takes so long or doesn't work in Telegram?

Telegram's embedding servers sometimes never send a request to embed a URL, often due to their servers being overloaded. Try using [Webpage Bot](https://t.me/WebpageBot) to clear the cached embed.

Be sure to replace the URL _before_ sending your message, as embeds usually don't update after you've already sent it.

## What if I don't want to display all images in a post?

You can pick a specific photo or video from a post using X/Twitter's own URL syntax. Append `/photo/N` or `/video/N` where N is the image or video number (starting from 1):

```
https://fxtwitter.com/user/status/123456789/photo/3
https://fxtwitter.com/user/status/123456789/video/2
```

## Is FxEmbed associated with [some other website that starts with fx]?

No. FxEmbed only operates on these domains:

- `fxtwitter.com` / `twittpr.com`
- `fixupx.com` (also `xfixup.com`)
- `fxbsky.app`

## How does FxEmbed handle privacy?

We believe privacy is a fundamental human right and avoid collecting data that is unnecessary.

The TL;DR is that we only log errors and non-identifying information - we don't share or sell any data or make it available to third parties.

We collect:

- Runtime errors: We will collect URLs and basic headers for errors that break embeds
- Account errors (X/Twitter): We collect only basic request information (post ID) to diagnose issues within our account proxy
- Basic analytics: We use Cloudflare Analytics Engine to collect basic, anonymous statistics that cannot identify individual users or posts. (i.e. bot user agent popularity, whether a request succeeded or not, etc.)

We do not collect:

- Who posts a link
- Who clicks on a link
- Any data that could identify a user or post (unless there's an error, see above)

We also strip tracking parameters (like `?s` and `&t`) from X/Twitter URLs to prevent them from being used for telemetry and advertising.

## Can I self-host FxEmbed?

Yes! See the [self-hosting guide](/deployment/) for setup instructions.

## What platforms does FxEmbed support as embed sources?

Currently:

- **X/Twitter** — via `fxtwitter.com`, `fixupx.com`, `twittpr.com`
- **Bluesky** — via `fxbsky.app`

## How do I contribute?

FxEmbed is open source on [GitHub](https://github.com/FxEmbed/FxEmbed). Pull requests are welcome! You can also help with [localization via Crowdin](https://crowdin.com/project/fxtwitter).

---

# getting-started.mdx

Source: https://github.com/fxembed/fxembed/blob/main/docs/src/content/docs/guide/getting-started.mdx

title: Getting Started
description: Learn how to use FxEmbed to create rich social media embeds in Discord, Telegram, and other platforms.

FxEmbed enhances embeds so that platforms like Discord and Telegram display rich embeds with videos, images, polls, quotes, and more.

## Quick Start

### X/Twitter Links

For `twitter.com` links, add **`fx`** before the domain:

```
https://twitter.com/user/status/123456789
→ https://fxtwitter.com/user/status/123456789
```

For `x.com` links, add **`fixup`** before the domain:

```
https://x.com/user/status/123456789
→ https://fixupx.com/user/status/123456789
```

### sed-style replacement

`twittpr.com` also works for `twitter.com` links. It was designed for Discord's sed-style replacement

Just send a `twitter.com` link, then type `s/e/p` to correct it to `twittpr.com`.

```
https://twitter.com/user/status/123456789
→ https://twittpr.com/user/status/123456789
```

### Bluesky Links

For `bsky.app` links, add **`fx`** before the domain:

```
https://bsky.app/profile/user.bsky.social/post/abc123
→ https://fxbsky.app/profile/user.bsky.social/post/abc123
```

## What Gets Embedded

FxEmbed provides richer embeds than the default behavior:

- **Videos and GIFs** play inline instead of showing a static thumbnail
- **Multiple images** display as a gallery
- **Polls** show live results with vote counts and percentages
- **Quotes** appear with their full text and media
- **External videos** (e.g. YouTube links in posts) can embed directly on Discord
- **Link shorteners** (`t.co`) are replaced with the original destination URL
- **Tracking parameters** are stripped on redirect for privacy

## Where It Works

We mainly target the following platforms:

- **Discord** — Full support for videos, GIFs, multi-image galleries, polls, quotes, and more
- **Telegram** — Same as Discord, plus [Instant View](/guide/built-in-features/#telegram-instant-view) support for thread reading

Any app that fetches OpenGraph metadata (WhatsApp, Slack, iMessage, etc.) will show improved embeds, but not all features may be supported by your platform.

---

# direct-media.mdx

Source: https://github.com/fxembed/fxembed/blob/main/docs/src/content/docs/guide/url-modifiers/direct-media.mdx

title: Direct media
description: Link straight to a post’s image or video file with the d. prefix or .mp4 / .jpg suffix.

Links directly to the post's media file without an embed wrapper.

```
https://d.fxtwitter.com/user/status/123456789
https://d.fixupx.com/user/status/123456789
https://d.fxbsky.app/profile/user.bsky.social/post/abc123
```

Appending `.mp4` or `.jpg` works the same way:

```
https://fxtwitter.com/user/status/123456789.mp4
https://fixupx.com/user/status/123456789.jpg
```

description: Minimal embed with media and author only—no post text or engagement counts.

Minimal embed showing only the post's media and author information, without text or engagement counts. Useful for media-focused channels where you still want to give the author credit.

```
https://g.fxtwitter.com/user/status/123456789
https://g.fixupx.com/user/status/123456789
```

# index.mdx

Source: https://github.com/fxembed/fxembed/blob/main/docs/src/content/docs/guide/url-modifiers/index.mdx

title: URL Modifiers
description: Subdomain flags and URL suffixes that change how FxEmbed renders your links.

FxEmbed supports a number of subdomain prefixes and URL suffixes to control embed behavior. These work across all supported domains (`fxtwitter.com`, `fixupx.com`, `fxbsky.app`).

| Modifier                                           | Syntax                               | Effect                      |
| -------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | --------------------------- |
| [Direct media](/guide/url-modifiers/direct-media/) | `d.` prefix, or `.mp4`/`.jpg` suffix | Link directly to media file |
| [Select photo](/guide/url-modifiers/select-photo/) | `/photo/{n}` suffix                  | Pick specific image         |
| [Translate](/guide/url-modifiers/translate/)       | `/{lang}` suffix                     | Translate post text         |
| [Mosaic](/guide/url-modifiers/mosaic/)             | `m.` prefix                          | Combine images into one     |
| [Gallery](/guide/url-modifiers/gallery/)           | `g.` prefix                          | Media + author only         |
| [Text-only](/guide/url-modifiers/text-only/)       | `t.` prefix                          | Text only, no media         |
| [Instant View](/guide/url-modifiers/instant-view/) | `i.` prefix                          | Telegram Instant View       |
| [Old embeds](/guide/url-modifiers/old-embeds/)     | `o.` prefix                          | Legacy Discord embed style  |

## Subdomain flags

Prepend these subdomains to change the embed style. Each modifier above has its own page with examples and screenshots.

Forces Telegram Instant View rendering for the linked post or thread.

```
https://i.fxtwitter.com/user/status/123456789

https://i.fxbsky.app/profile/user.bsky.social/post/abc123
```

Combines multiple images from a single post into one composite image.

# select-photo.mdx

Source: https://github.com/fxembed/fxembed/blob/main/docs/src/content/docs/guide/url-modifiers/select-photo.mdx

title: Select media
description: Target a specific image or video in a multi-media post with /photo or /video paths.

You can target a specific image or video from a multi-media post to only embed one:

```
https://fxtwitter.com/user/status/123456789/photo/3
https://fixupx.com/user/status/123456789/video/2
```

You can stack this with the [direct media](/guide/url-modifiers/direct-media/) flag to link directly to a specific image or video:

```
https://d.fxtwitter.com/user/status/123456789/photo/3
https://d.fixupx.com/user/status/123456789/video/2
```

title: Text-only
description: Show post text without photos or videos using the t. prefix.

The opposite of gallery, shows only the post text and excludes all photos and videos.

```
https://t.fxtwitter.com/user/status/123456789
https://t.fixupx.com/user/status/123456789
https://t.fxbsky.app/profile/user.bsky.social/post/abc123
```

# translate.mdx

Source: https://github.com/fxembed/fxembed/blob/main/docs/src/content/docs/guide/url-modifiers/translate.mdx

title: Translate
description: Append a language code to show translated post text

Append a two-letter ISO 639-1 language code to translate the post

```
https://fxtwitter.com/user/status/123456789/en
https://fixupx.com/user/status/123456789/es
https://fxbsky.app/profile/user.bsky.social/post/abc123/en
```

The embed will display both the original text and the translation.

## What is FxEmbed?

FxEmbed powers **FxTwitter**, **FixupX**, and **FxBluesky** — services that turn social media links into rich embeds with videos, polls, quotes, translations, and more. Just change a URL prefix and share it in Discord, Telegram, or anywhere that supports link previews.

<CardGrid>
  <Card title="Embed Videos & GIFs" icon="seti:video">
    Videos and GIFs embed directly, share memes, clips, and other videos directly in-line.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Polls & Quotes" icon="comment">
    See poll results and quoted posts in-line, with media support for quoted content.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Translate Posts" icon="translate">
    Translate posts into any supported language by appending a language code to the URL.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Public API" icon="approve-check">
    Use the public FxTwitter and FxBluesky APIs to power your own projects.
  </Card>
</CardGrid>

## Supported Platforms

| Source Platform           | Domain Prefix | Example                            |
| ------------------------- | ------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| X/Twitter (`twitter.com`) | Add `fx`      | `fxtwitter.com/user/status/123`    |
| X (`x.com`)               | Add `fixup`   | `fixupx.com/user/status/123`       |
| Bluesky (`bsky.app`)      | Add `fx`      | `fxbsky.app/profile/user/post/abc` |
